dedupe_keys.name: anonymized query log dataset for the aktin infrastructure

description: Jonas Bienzeisler at RWTH Aachen publishes anonymised query-level logs from the AKTIN emergency-department data-access system. The Zenodo UTF-8 CSV is free under CC BY 4.0. Fields identify anonymised requests and nodes, final query status, processing time, completion or rejection delays, calendar year and automatic-rule use. These observations can calibrate workflow latency and completion probabilities in federated healthcare-information simulations. Related catalogue record data-aktin-emergency-department-length-of-stay concerns patient stays, a different quantity. Coverage is the AKTIN broker workflow in Germany; exact years and node counts are not stated in the deposit. Identifiers are replaced and timestamps converted to intervals, so the data cannot recreate real facility identities or precise event timing. Rounding, unsuccessful-query handling and completeness require checking. No CSV was downloaded, patient information accessed or system-performance claims independently reproduced.
